aurelianflo/pricing.note: $0.05 per call, whatever the number of wallets. PDF/DOCX output adds $0.05.

description: Order a backlog of wallets for manual review. Wallets that are on the sanctions list now come first and show no score; the rest are ordered by a priority score built from the figures you supply (exposure, relationship tier, recent activity, policy priority), and from exposure report rows if you pass them as addresses_from_exposure. Exposure and tier are optional: a figure you leave out is treated as unknown, and the row says so. Each row says why it sits where it does, and a line marks where your review capacity runs out. It does not predict future listings. Use compliance_exposure_report for on-chain evidence about specific wallets. Up to 100 wallets per call, counting review_items and addresses_from_exposure together. To keep the queue in your account, call saved_results_save with its screening_id. Price without an account: $0.05 per call, whatever the number of wallets. PDF/DOCX output adds $0.05.

addresses_from_exposure.description: Optional rows from an exposure report (the wallets array of a compliance_exposure_report result). The queue uses what the report found about each wallet, such as listed counterparties and transfer counts, and adds any wallet that is not already in review_items. A queue holds at most 100 wallets, so review_items and these rows together must not name more than 100 different wallets.

items.description: One wallet row from an exposure report.

asset.description: Optional asset or network ticker filter such as ETH, USDC, XBT, TRX, ARB, or BSC. It never hides a listed address: one listed under another asset is still a match, with assetFilterMatched false in the summary. Letters and digits only, 2 to 10 characters.

output_format.description: json (default) for the structured result, or pdf/docx to also get a generated report artifact.

response_detail.description: summary (default) returns a short text summary for you to read, with the full result in structuredContent. full returns the full JSON as text as well.

review_budget.description: How many wallets can be reviewed in the next review window.

review_items.description: Wallets to order, up to 100 (together with any extra wallets from addresses_from_exposure), each with the figures the order is built from.

current_queue_position.description: Optional current queue rank, where 1 is first. When every item has one, the result compares the new order with it.

exposure_usd.description: Dollar exposure associated with this wallet. Leave it out if you do not know it: it is then treated as unknown, not as zero.

label.description: Optional display label for the wallet.

last_activity_days.description: Days since the wallet was last active.

policy_priority.description: Optional internal policy priority from 0 to 10.

relationship_tier.description: Relationship tier for this wallet. Leave it out if you do not know it.

tier_weights.description: Optional overrides for the relationship tier weights.

listed_now.description: True when the wallet is an exact match on the OFAC SDN list.

missing_figures.description: Figures that were not supplied and were treated as unknown.

ordering.description: What placed the wallet: the list (listed_now) or its score.

priority_score.description: Score from the supplied figures. Null for a wallet listed now, and for a wallet with no figures.

relationship_tier.description: Tier supplied for the wallet; null when it was not supplied.

why.description: One line on why the wallet sits where it does.

within_capacity.description: True when the wallet falls inside the review capacity.
